message.pageDescription.message: Manage your connected third-party services. These connections allow the AceDataCloud app to perform actions on your behalf.

message.noConnections.description: Message indicating there are no connectors.

message.notConnectedYet.message: Not connected. Click to start authorization.

message.noConnectionsHint.message: You can get a richer experience in applications like ChatGPT, Claude, etc., after connecting services.
message.noConnectionsHint.description: Hint for users about the benefits of connecting services.

message.connectConfirm.message: You will be redirected to {provider} for authorization.
message.connectConfirm.description: Confirmation message for connecting to a provider.

message.selectScopes.description: Prompt to select authorization scopes for the provider.

message.selectScopesHint.message: Select the permissions you wish to authorize. Multiple selections are allowed; by default, only basic login information is granted.

message.refreshed.description: Message indicating the connection was successfully refreshed.

message.customConnectorHint.message: Connect to a remote MCP server that supports OAuth.
message.customConnectorHint.description: Hint for using a custom connector.

message.customConnectorTrust.message: Only add connectors you trust. The tools and data permissions provided by the connector are controlled by the corresponding service.

message.callbackMissingParams.message: Authorization callback is missing required parameters, please re-initiate the connection.

message.selectConnector.message: Select a connector on the left to view details
message.selectConnector.description: Instruction to select a connector for more information.

message.manageUnavailable.description: Shown when Manage is clicked on a directory card but no matching connection row could be found, e.g. the connections list failed to load.

message.connectedAccounts.description: Tooltip and accessible name for the green badge on a connected directory card, which shows only the number. Phrase it so no word has to agree grammatically with {count} (languages with three plural forms cannot render 'N accounts' from a single string).

message.toolsLoading.message: Loading tools provided by the server…
message.toolsLoading.description: Message indicating tools are being loaded.

message.installFailed.message: Failed to add, please try again later.

message.desktopUpdateRequired.message: Please update the desktop app to connect.
message.desktopUpdateRequired.description: Shown when the desktop shell is too old to open a connector's consent page.

message.installed.description: Message indicating a connector has been added.

message.tryItHint.message: Click the prompt below to continue in the Studio chat.
message.tryItHint.description: Hint for trying out a feature in the Studio chat.

message.installRedirecting.description: Status text shown on the deep-link install page while the redirect is being prepared.

message.installMissingId.message: The connector to add is not specified.

message.installInvalidReturnTo.message: The return target is not trusted; redirect refused.
message.installInvalidReturnTo.description: Error shown when a deep-link install URL carries a return_to outside the trusted allow-list.

message.installBYOCUnsupported.message: Enter your credentials in the form that just opened to finish connecting.
message.installBYOCUnsupported.description: Prompt shown when a BYOC connector deep-link install opens the inline credential form.

message.browserSessionPairingOnly.message: This connector uses a local browser session. Pair ACE Browser Agent first; no credentials will be collected here.
message.browserSessionPairingOnly.description: Fail-closed notice for a browser_session connector before pairing a local browser device.

message.browserSessionPairedNotInstalled.message: Device paired. This connector remains unavailable until its browser-session producer is enabled; no cloud authorization was created.
message.browserSessionPairedNotInstalled.description: Shown after device pairing when the browser_session connector is still hidden and not installable.

message.browserPairedIncompatible.message: Device v{version} is still incompatible. Missing: {capabilities}. Update Browser Agent or pair another device.

message.browserHighPrivilegeDisclosure.message: This connector can read pages and perform clicks, typing, uploads, downloads, and publishing actions on the declared sites through the selected local browser. Only choose a device you control.

message.browserIncompatibility.device_in.message: This device is inactive or revoked.

message.browserIncompatibility.wire_cont.message: Browser Agent uses a different execution contract. Update the extension.

message.browserIncompatibility.extension.message: Browser Agent is too old. Update the extension.

message.browserIncompatibility.device_of.message: Browser Agent is offline. Open the extension on this device.

message.browserRebindSuccess.message: Browser device changed. Existing sessions were stopped, and scheduled browser authorizations using the old revision must be confirmed again.

message.renamePrompt.message: Name this account (this is how you tell several accounts of one connector apart)

message.renameTooLong.message: Name must be 64 characters or fewer

byoc.dialogTitle.description: Title for the dialog to add credentials.

byoc.intro.message: Please fill in the access key obtained from the service console. These credentials are only used to call the corresponding cloud/SaaS API on your behalf.

byoc.submit.description: Button text for saving and enabling the credentials.

byoc.disclaimer.message: Credentials are stored encrypted with AES-256-GCM; during Skill execution, they are only briefly decrypted in sandbox memory and never written in plaintext to the database/logs/API responses. You can disconnect at any time on this page to invalidate them.
byoc.disclaimer.description: Disclaimer about the security of credentials.

byoc.extensionIntro.message: Cookie-based connectors require the ACE browser extension. It captures your login session to connect — no password or token needed.

byoc.extensionStepLogin.message: Log in to the platform in a new tab.

byoc.extensionStepCapture.message: Click "Capture & Connect"; the ACE browser extension reads your login cookies and connects.

byoc.extensionMissing.message: ACE browser extension not detected. Please install it and try again.

byoc.extensionNoCookies.message: No login cookies found — make sure you are logged in to the platform in another tab.

byoc.extensionMissingBody.message: Connecting captures your login session with the ACE extension — no password or token. Install it first, then come back.
